name: a link that walks out on backslashes
why: A browser folds a backslash into a slash before it resolves the path, so this lands on https://github.com/attacker/evil too, and refusing the literal '..' alone would let it through. A backslash is now refused wherever it appears in a fact's text, so that is the rule this fails on, before its links are read; the address itself is pinned as refused in tests/test_rules.py.

rows.headline: the rule that would have frozen every merge
